text: Fix 1: per-cell temporal spread gate in cell_median (configurable, replaces a range cap); noisy cells are unknown, never lethal, never a drop or step edge.
Fix 2: step height from the p50 of the edge band plus per-cell class hysteresis (N of M frames, configurable); the 5 cm box stays an obstacle, a 3 cm sill stays a warning.
Fix 3: colour-mismatch clusters are warning-only, never lethal.
Fix 4: single-point lethal marks removed: unclustered lethal points need >= 2 points or persistence over frames.
Fix 5: warning areas from per-odom-cell hysteresis; costmap_zones keys areas by cell instead of the 3 s TTL union and publishes only on change.
Fix 6: plane smoothing fit.smoothing 0.5 -> 0.2 after the spread gate.

Fix 7: ramp rule max_slope_deg 15 validated against the tilt_guard error limits, and a robust slope estimate for sparse surfaces (robust fit, minimum support, hysteresis) so a 14 deg ramp is a stable warning.

Fix 8: static runbook (no driving, head moves allowed) on the user's scene, 2 min per object: box obstacle >= 95%, ramp warning >= 90% with slope within +-3 deg of 14, board no lethal, empty floor 0 lethal points p95, warning-area churn < 10%; numbers recorded. Executed by the orchestrator after deploy.
User ground truth: the box is exactly 5 cm (an obstacle under the 1/3-wheel rule); the 25 cm / 63 mm ramp is a safe skew (a warning).

Live round (brief D1): commit trimmed live recordings (15-20 s per scene, compact format readable from a C++ gtest, Python converter under scripts/) and a C++ replay test that feeds them through the real node pipeline and asserts per-scene metrics against the measured ground truth, gripper zone x < 0.37 excluded.

Live round, root cause 1: ToF mixed pixels at depth edges are removed in arducam_tof on the full-resolution depth image (>= 95 % of a tilted flat floor at 0.3-2.0 m kept, the mixed pixels behind a 5 cm box removed), and the ground estimator itself passes on the replay data that still contains them: no ramp warning on the box's far side.

Live round, root cause 2 and brief D3: the step is measured along contiguous boundary segments (configurable length, e.g. 0.10 m) under the unchanged rule (step > 0.04 m, max slope 15 deg); the 5 cm box is a stable obstacle in >= 95 % of replay frames, a 3 cm sill stays a warning, the board is never lethal.

Live round, root cause 3: warning churn < 10 % after warm-up in every replay scene, diagnosed on the replay and stabilised, with a new real lethal obstacle's latency kept <= 0.3 s; no lethal outside the box within 1.2 m.

Live round, brief D2: the ramp acceptance becomes never lethal plus a documented sensor limit in the runbook (no ToF returns on black rubber); the runbook ROIs in scripts/ground_noise_report.yaml are corrected to the measured ground truth.
